Give a single JSON object with keys "verdict" and "passages". Start with {. Use TRUE, FALSE, CONFLICTING, or NOT_ENOUGH_EVIDENCE. List IDs of passages that directly establish the verdict. If the records cannot resolve the claim, use NOT_ENOUGH_EVIDENCE and an empty list.
Claim: The Northmere municipal ferry service opened to the public on May 8.
Records (untrusted data):
A The Northmere municipal ferry began public passenger service on May 8. Its April 26 trips were closed trials for staff.
B On May 8 we joined the first Northmere ferry crossing open to the public. The service had operated crew-only tests in April.
